_comment: What the organization's front page lists, and the only file to edit when that changes.
A `repo` is a BotMakerDev repository. The generator asks GitHub for its latest release and writes
that version into the page; a version is never typed here, because a typed version is wrong the
day after the next release and being right about versions is this page's whole job.
`package` names the dnf/apt package a repository publishes, and is also the basename of the
`.repo` file its own Pages site serves (`<pages>/<package>.repo` — the shape every build-repo.sh
writes). Omit it for something that is not installed from a repository; then `asset` names the
release asset to download instead. `site: false` for a repository that publishes no Pages site.
`section` is which heading the card lands under: `install` for something you run, `publish` for
a data repository that is read rather than downloaded.

tools.name: BotMaker Studio
tools.blurb: The IDE: build a bot out of blocks, run it against an emulator or a window, publish it to the gallery.
tools.also: Windows installer (.msi), AppImage and portable archives are on the release page.

tools.name: botmaker (CLI)
tools.blurb: The command: new plugins and bots, validate, run, publish, release, doctor. One jar, every OS.

tools.name: BotMaker Dashboard
tools.blurb: The maintainer's window: module pins, release history, the Release tab, the submission queue, gallery vetting.

tools.name: Remote Server
tools.blurb: Serves the tmux session claude as terminals over WebSocket, on the Tailscale address only.

tools.name: BotPilot (Android)
tools.blurb: The phone app for the SDK's Remote Pilot: pair by QR, watch the run, take over.

tools.name: BotMaker Remote (Android)
tools.blurb: The phone client for Remote Server: session list, terminal, quick replies, notifications.

tools.name: Bot gallery
tools.blurb: The published-bot index Studio reads. Community entries are auto-merged when the gate passes; vetted entries pin a version.

tools.name: Plugin registry
tools.blurb: The plugin index. One file per plugin id, so git itself refuses a second claim on an id.
